_meta.source: Round 10 - Direct CDS PDF extraction (SDSU, SJSU, KSU, OSU, UGA)
_meta.purpose: State school residency admit rates from official CDS PDFs

schools.notes: UGA CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 42436 (in-state 19041 / oos 22113 / intl 1282), admitted 16092 (in-state 8946 / oos 6878 / intl 268). Intl 268/1282=20.9%, oos 31.1%, in-state 47.0%.

SDSU CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 90504 (in-state 81487 / oos 7741 / intl 1276), admitted 32556 (in-state 25091 / oos 6739 / intl 726). CSU pattern: in-state most competitive, OOS/intl easier. Intl 56.9%, oos 87.1%, in-state 30.8%.

KSU CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 15432 (in-state 6381 / oos 7553 / intl 1498), admitted 12653 (in-state 5844 / oos 6365 / intl 453). Intl notably selective (30.2%) vs domestic (84-92%). In-state 91.6%, OOS 84.3%.

SJSU CDS 2024-25 C1: total applied 37132 / admitted 31419 = 84.6%. In-state 35162/29918=85.1%, OOS 1197/929=77.6%. International column uncertain (4th column may be 'Unknown' not intl). CSU system school.
